name: Numerous
tagline: Numerous is an AI layer for Google Sheets and Excel that adds AI-powered functions directly into spreadsheet cells. You can classify text, extract entities, translate content, or generate new data with a formula — no coding or API setup required. Analysts and operations teams use it to process large datasets with AI logic inside the spreadsheet tools they already use every day.
